Header: Cnaphalocrocis medinalis (Guenee) หนอนห่อใบข้าว

Prevention: If direct seeding use sowing rate of 15-20 kg/ rai
Plant more than 2 varieties in the same field with same harvesting day
Nitrogen fertilizer rate: 46-0-0 not over 10 kg/ rai. 16-20-0 not over 30 kg/rai
Control grass weeds to remove alternate hosts
Conserve natural enemies such as small wasps, crickets, damselflies, ants, beetles and spiders by avoiding unnecessary insecticide sprays in the first 40 days
Direct Control (Non-chemical): ETL: if leaf damage is more than 15%, use direct control.
If 4-5 adults / m 2 use direct control
Direct Control (Chemical): B. bassiana every week when larvae are present
Restrictions: IRAC 1A, WHO II, Spray at larva stage
IRAC 22A, WHO II, Spray at larva stage
Don’t apply insecticides in first 40 days after sowing or transplanting.
Don’t apply granular insecticide, don’t mix insecticides, don’t use 36 chemicals in the
RD list (will kill natural enemies and cause resistance)
